evals.prompt: This function has no tests. Add a test suite that covers its edge cases and run it.
evals.expected_output: Tests covering the boundary cases (pct=0, pct=100, and an invalid/negative pct), a note on the missing input validation, and a report that the tests were run.
assertions: Tests are added for the boundary cases (0% and 100% discount)
An edge/invalid case (e.g. negative or >100 percentage) is called out as untested or unguarded
The tests are run and their pass/fail result is reported
The summary lists the tests added

evals.prompt: The existing test only covers the happy path. Strengthen the suite and run it.
evals.expected_output: New tests for the empty-list and even-length cases added alongside the existing test (not replacing it), with a run report.
assertions: A test is added for the empty-input case
A test is added for the even-length case (median of two middle values)
The existing happy-path test is preserved, not weakened or deleted
The tests are run and the result is reported

evals.prompt: Spec: clamp(value, lo, hi) must return a value within [lo, hi]. Write a test that verifies the spec and report whether the implementation meets it.
evals.expected_output: A test asserting clamping at and beyond both bounds; running it reveals the implementation fails the upper-bound case, which is reported (the QA role tests and reports, it does not fix).
assertions: A test asserts behavior at and beyond both the lower and upper bounds
Running the test reveals the upper-bound defect, which is reported as a failure
The role reports the defect rather than silently editing the implementation to pass

component.purpose: Design, write, and run tests for a change (existing + new unit tests and end-to-end coverage), report coverage gaps and results; it strengthens the suite and never weakens a test to make it pass.
